response.sql: SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.equipstatus <> 'Maintenance' GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Only telescopes whose equipment status is known and is not 'Maintenance' contribute to the averages and counts.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every telescope at a station if that station has at least one telescope whose equipment status is not 'Maintenance'.
alternatives.sql: SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t INNER JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM telescopes AS active_t WHERE active_t.observstation = t.observstation AND active_t.equipstatus <> 'Maintenance') GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10;
